title: Maple & Cedar Swing
author: Bob Green
problems: Row 1 "half poussette - robins pull neighbors back then left" can't start from where the dancers are: The pairs must stand apart to poussette.
Row 4 "mad robins, twos in front" can't start from where the dancers are: mad robin front must be one of larks, robins; got 2s.
Row 5 "half poussette - robins pull neighbors back then left" can't start from where the dancers are: The pairs must stand apart to poussette.
The progression after row 8 "neighbors do si do once larks same neighbor, robins new neighbor" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
choices: The 1s end their swing side by side in the middle of the set facing down, the way they progress.
